full_judgment: 2. Opposite party No. 1 as appellant filed an application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for pre-empting 30 decimals of land of plot No. 887 In Khatian No. 205 of Mouja South Alipur; Feni District, Noakhali on the averment that the applicant was co share of the holding by inheritance and Opp. party No. 2 Abo Tayeb sold the case and to the petitioner opposite party who was a stranger by kabala dated 8-9-69 for a consideration of Tk. 3000.00 No notice of transfer was served upon the applicant who came to know of the transfer for the first time in the month of February, 1975. Thereafter, the petitioner obtained certified copy and filed the application for pre-emption on depositing consideration and compensation. The application was opposed by opposite party No 1 who is petitioner here contending inter alia, that the Pre-emptor-applicant was aware of the transfer for the last 6 rear and the application was hopelessly time-barred on these pleadings two issues were raised before the learned Munsif which are as follows:-
